About.title: Mediterranean meals made simple, healthy, and unforgettable.
About.subtitle: Healthy Mezze celebrates fresh ingredients, easy recipes, and balanced Mediterranean-inspired eating designed for every home cook.
About.ourStoryParagraph1: Healthy Mezze was created to make healthy Mediterranean cooking simple, approachable, and enjoyable for everyone. Inspired by the rich culinary traditions of Egypt, Lebanon, Greece, Turkey, Syria, Jordan, and Palestine, our goal is to help home cooks prepare delicious meals using fresh ingredients and straightforward techniques.
About.ourStoryParagraph2: Every recipe is designed with everyday home kitchens in mind. We focus on balanced nutrition, practical ingredients, clear step-by-step instructions, and authentic Mediterranean flavors that are easy to recreate at home.
About.valuesTitle: Built on flavor, health, and tradition.
About.commitmentTitle: What you can expect from Healthy Mezze
About.commitmentDescription: We strive to publish recipes that are carefully written, easy to follow, and inspired by authentic Mediterranean cooking traditions. Our nutrition information is intended for general guidance and should not replace professional medical or dietary advice.

Cookies.title: Cookie Policy
Cookies.metaDescription: Learn how Healthy Mezze uses cookies, analytics, browser storage, and advertising technologies to improve your experience.
Cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how Healthy Mezze uses cookies and similar technologies when you visit and use our website.

whatAreCookies.title: What Are Cookies?
whatAreCookies.content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help websites remember information about your visit, improve functionality, and understand how visitors use the site.

howWeUse.title: How We Use Cookies
howWeUse.intro: Healthy Mezze may use cookies and similar technologies for the following purposes:

items.preferences: To remember your preferences and settings.
items.performance: To understand website performance and improve the user experience.
items.behavior: To understand how visitors interact with our website.
items.traffic: To measure website traffic and usage patterns.
items.ads: To support advertising and personalized advertising where applicable.
items.security: To help maintain website security and prevent abuse.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.content: We may use analytics services to understand how visitors use Healthy Mezze, including information such as pages viewed, approximate usage patterns, and general website performance.

clarity.title: Microsoft Clarity
clarity.content: Healthy Mezze may use Microsoft Clarity to better understand how visitors interact with the website through usage analytics and session insights.

adsense.title: Advertising and Google AdSense
adsense.content: Healthy Mezze may use Google AdSense and related advertising technologies to display advertisements. These services may use cookies or similar technologies to provide, measure, and improve advertising.

browserStorage.title: Browser Storage
browserStorage.content: Some website features may use browser storage technologies, such as local storage, to remember information on your device. For example, your favorite recipes may be stored locally in your browser.

managing.title: Managing Cookies
managing.content: You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may affect some website functionality.

changes.title: Changes to This Cookie Policy
changes.content: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes to our website, services, or legal requirements. Any updates will be posted on this page.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have questions about this Cookie Policy, you can contact us at:

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.metaDescription: Learn how Healthy Mezze collects, uses, and protects your information.
Privacy.intro: Healthy Mezze respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have regarding your data when you use our website.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.body: By accessing Healthy Mezze, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy. We encourage you to read this page carefully to understand how your information is handled.

information.title: Information We Collect
information.body: Depending on how you interact with Healthy Mezze, we may collect the following information:

items.email: Email address when you voluntarily subscribe to our newsletter.
items.pages: Pages you visit and how long you stay on them.
items.time: Date and time of your visit.
items.analytics: Anonymous analytics data collected through services such as Google Analytics.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: We use analytics tools to better understand how visitors use Healthy Mezze. These tools collect anonymous information that helps us improve the website, user experience, and our recipe content.

newsletter.title: Newsletter
newsletter.body: If you choose to subscribe to our newsletter, we only use your email address to send recipes, cooking tips, updates, and occasional announcements.
newsletter.unsubscribe: You can unsubscribe at any time by clicking the unsubscribe link included in every email.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.body: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, update, or request deletion of your personal information. You may also object to certain processing activities where permitted by law.

clarity.body: Healthy Mezze never sells your personal information. We collect only the information necessary to operate, improve, and secure our website.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: Healthy Mezze uses cookies to improve website functionality, remember your preferences, analyze traffic, and provide a better browsing experience.
cookies.preferences: You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings at any time.

adsense.title: Advertising
adsense.body: Healthy Mezze may display advertisements through Google AdSense. Google and its partners may use cookies to serve personalized or non-personalized advertisements based on your browsing activity.

links.title: External Links
links.body: Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of external websites.

security.title: Data Security
security.body: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information. However, no method of internet transmission or electronic storage is completely secure.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be published on this page together with the updated revision date.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: Healthy Mezze is dedicated to making healthy Mediterranean cooking simple, enjoyable, and accessible. Our goal is to publish recipes that are practical for everyday home cooks while respecting the rich culinary traditions of Mediterranean cuisine.

recipeDevelopment.title: Recipe Development
recipeDevelopment.text: Every recipe is carefully written with clear ingredients, step-by-step instructions, preparation times, and estimated nutrition information. We focus on fresh ingredients, balanced meals, and techniques that are easy to follow.

accuracy.title: Accuracy

independence.title: Independence

FAQ.metaDescription: Find answers to common questions about Healthy Mezze, our Mediterranean recipes, ingredients, nutrition information, and cooking tips.
FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.description: Here are answers to some of the questions we receive most often.

whatIsHealthyMezze.question: What is Healthy Mezze?
whatIsHealthyMezze.answer: Healthy Mezze is a recipe website dedicated to healthy Mediterranean-inspired meals made with fresh, wholesome ingredients and easy-to-follow instructions.

beginnerFriendly.question: Are your recipes beginner friendly?
beginnerFriendly.answer: Yes. Our recipes are written with clear, step-by-step instructions that are suitable for cooks of all experience levels.

nutrition.question: Do you provide nutrition information?
nutrition.answer: Yes. Nutrition information is included as an estimate to help readers make informed choices. Values may vary depending on ingredients and portion sizes.

substitutions.question: Can I substitute ingredients?
substitutions.answer: Absolutely. Many Mediterranean recipes are flexible, and ingredient substitutions are often possible based on availability or dietary preferences.

vegetarianVegan.question: Do you publish vegetarian and vegan recipes?
vegetarianVegan.answer: Yes. Healthy Mezze offers a variety of vegetarian and vegan Mediterranean recipes alongside dishes featuring seafood, poultry, and other proteins.

contact.question: How can I contact Healthy Mezze?
contact.answer: You can reach us anytime at contact@healthymezze.com through our Contact page.
